persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīman nepālamahīmaṇḍala ramaṇa śṛīśrījaya bhūpatīndramalladeva viracite

notes: The quoted colophon text is only an act-ending formula naming king Jayabhūpatīndramalla as the author. The copying date (NS 826 phālguṇa kṛṣṇa 13) and place (Bhaktapur) listed in the catalogue fields are absent from this excerpt.
